methodology.matching: Exact model and storage/RAM/network variant where the source states these fields. Do not mix 4G and 5G, RAM/storage variants, used and new, or different regional versions.
methodology.warranty: Warranty and seller identity are not confirmed for every marketplace listing. Compare price separately from warranty and seller risk.
methodology.market_statistic: Median of the individually listed non-Vodafone offers in this snapshot. This is not an all-market weighted average.
methodology.refresh: Research snapshot only. Prices must be rechecked at retailer checkout; no direct retailer feeds are connected yet.

comparisons.source_note: Prices Tracker snapshot dated 5 Nov 2026. Exact core variant: iPhone 18 Pro 256GB Glacier. B.TECH (drmobile) 124,850 EGP, listed in stock; 2B last known 109,899 EGP and Tradeline 109,900 EGP, both marked sold out by tracker. Vodafone Egypt last known 109,899 EGP, marked sold out. Ennap at 84,999 EGP is excluded because it is an international version without local agent warranty. The market median of the three exact-core competitor references is EGP 109,900, but two are sold out; the only tracker-confirmed in-stock comparable is B.TECH at EGP 124,850. 2B's own direct product result for the Black colour showed EGP 109,899 and one unit left, but that is a different colour and its stock state conflicts with tracker observations; do not merge it into the Glacier comparison.
comparisons.market_statistic: Median of exact-core-variant last-known competitor prices, including out-of-stock observations. Current in-stock minimum is reported separately.
